title: Gibson Modern Hardshell Case, Flying V, Black

long_description.body:
Gibson Modern Series hardshell cases are designed to protect your Gibson instrument in style. Featuring the highest quality materials and hardware, they meet Gibson's stringent factory specifications and are available in a variety of sizes so they'll fit your cherished Gibson like a glove.





4 heavy duty latches




Accessory compartment




Black plush interior lining




Internal dimensions: 47.50” length, 6.625” upper body width, 18.25” lower body width, 4.13” depth.
